D: A runaway heiress travels by bus from Miami to New York with a reporter who wants her story.
P: Serve dessert when Peter shows Ellie how to dunk a doughnut.
S: Baby carrots with herb sour cream dip
Baby carrots with a chive, dill and lemon sour cream dip
Young carrots peeled and served raw, standing in a glass, with a creamy dip of sour cream, chives, dill and lemon.
Buttered white bread with ham, cheddar and yellow mustard
Buttered white bread with ham, cheddar and yellow mustard, cut in halves and wrapped in baking paper for the trip.
sour cucumber slices in a crisp cornmeal crust, fried hot, with cold buttermilk ranch dip

Dill pickle chips in a crisp cornmeal crust, fried hot and salted, with a cold buttermilk ranch dip on the side. Drain 400g dill pickle slices and pat very dry. Whisk 1 egg with 125ml buttermilk. Mix 75g plain flour, 75g fine cornmeal, 1 tsp paprika and salt. Dip the pickles in the buttermilk, then the flour mix. Fry in batches in oil at 180C for 2 minutes until golden, drain and salt. For the dip, mix 100g sour cream, 60ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill, chives and a crushed garlic clove.
M: Bacon and scrambled eggs on toast
Crisp bacon and soft scrambled eggs on buttered toast
Soft scrambled eggs, crisp bacon and buttered toast, served on tin plates with chives scattered over the eggs.
Roadside diner pot roast with gravy
the long trip north to New York by bus, car and foot

Beef chuck seared hard and braised for hours with onion, carrot and stock until it pulls apart, with potatoes cooked in the juices and a thick gravy. Heat the oven to 160C. Season 1.5kg beef chuck and brown all over in oil in a casserole. Remove. Fry 2 onions and 3 carrots in chunks for 5 minutes, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp plain flour, then 750ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and thyme. Return the beef, cover and cook 2 hours. Add 800g halved potatoes and cook 1 hour more. Lift out the beef and vegetables and simmer the liquid until it thickens to gravy.
W: Fried yeast doughnut rings, golden and soft
Yeasted doughnuts fried at 175C until golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with hot coffee for dunking.
K: Strong coffee, hot milk and dark chocolate with cinnamon and brown sugar

Strong coffee whisked with melted dark chocolate, hot milk and cinnamon, poured into thick mugs and topped with whipped cream and grated chocolate. Brew 500ml strong coffee. In a saucepan, heat 500ml milk with 100g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp ground cinnamon, whisking until the chocolate melts and it steams, about 5 minutes. Whisk in the coffee. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks. Pour the mocha into 4 thick mugs, spoon over the cream and grate a little more chocolate on top. Serve with the doughnuts for dunking.

Prove the dough until doubled, which is the first resting time.

s.note: Baby carrots with a chive, dill and lemon sour cream dip
s.how: Peel a bag of baby carrots and stand them upright in a glass. Mix 300ml sour cream with snipped chives, chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon. Serve the carrots with the dip, a better roadside meal than the one in the film.

s.note: Buttered white bread with ham, cheddar and yellow mustard
s.how: Butter white bread and fill with sliced ham, cheddar and a stripe of yellow mustard. Cut in halves and wrap each in baking paper. Pack them into a bag for a long overnight bus ride from Miami to New York.

m.n: Bacon and scrambled eggs on toast
m.note: Crisp bacon and soft scrambled eggs on buttered toast
m.how: Fry 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Whisk 8 eggs with salt and scramble slowly in butter until soft. Toast and butter white bread. Serve it all on tin plates with chives scattered over the eggs, behind the walls of Jericho.

w.note: Fried yeast doughnut rings, golden and soft
w.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 2 eggs, 50g butter and warm milk into a soft dough and prove an hour. Roll, cut into rings and prove again. Fry at 175C until golden, then roll in cinnamon sugar. Dunk them properly, the way the film teaches.
